messages:
kkim: Heads up — onboarding for zephyr-7b is hitting config-lint in CI. root error: \"incompatible tokenizer.vocab_size vs config.vocab_size\" and also a warning about an unknown field 'padding_side'. Anyone seen this exact combo before?

jpatel: hmm. did the tokenizer.json reference change? sometimes tokenizer get exported with a trailing _v2 and we forget to update config.json path.

sara: I saw this earlier with another model. quick repro: run the local linter:
```
./tools/config-lint --file model/config.json --schema=serving-v3
```
output snippet: 
```
ERROR: tokenizer.vocab_size (50266) != config.vocab_size (50257)
WARN: unknown_field 'padding_side' (allowed: pad_token_id, bos_token_id, eos_token_id)
```

kkim: yup that matches CI. The weights team uploaded two tarballs — one to gs://redwood-models/zephyr/7b/weights.tar and another with same model but tokenizer in gs://redwood-models/zephyr/7b/tokenizer_v2/tokenizer.json. CI config points at tokenizer_v2 but config.json still lists the old relative path.

ml-gatekeeper: Gatekeeper note: model onboarding requires matching vocab_size and explicit tokenizer path. See onboarding checklist -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-onboard.md :eyes:

jpatel: simplest fix: update config.json to point to the tokenizer_v2 path AND add an explicit override for padding_side if exporter included it. e.g. add \"tokenizer_overrides\": { \"padding_side\": \"right\" } so the lint doesn't warn.

sara: also check for special token IDs. the tokenizer_v2 export used an eos as id 2 but config had eos as 1. quick patch in tokenizer to remap isn't horrible, but easier is to make config reflect tokenizer (serving reads config first).

kkim: i'm worried about shifting vocab_size silently. can we have the linter fail hard on mismatched vocab_size? current setup is WARN only.

jpatel: we can change that. i'll open a tiny PR to promote the vocab_size mismatch to ERROR in `tools/config-lint` and add a small message that points to a token-mapping script.

kkim: great. can you also add a helpful hint in the error that says: \"run tools/token-remap --tokenizer <path> --map eos:1,eos:2\" or similar? saves a ping later.

jpatel: will do. creating PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3442 (WIP). assigning to @sara for review.

sara: ack, i'll review after standup. also, @kkim please confirm which weights tarball is canonical so I can update the model registry entry.

kkim: canonical weights are the one in gs://redwood-models/zephyr/7b/weights.tar (the tokenizer_v2 upload was a follow-up). i'll delete the stray one after we finish onboarding to avoid confusion.

deploy-bot: ci/build 3421 — config-lint job failed on zephyr-7b (same errors). (reacts :construction:)
